invariants.description: N-type Ca activation c matches the exact clamp solution c_inf(V) + (c_init - c_inf) exp(-t/tau), tau = |tau_c(V)|/1000 + epsilon_tau (0.001 ms)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(c - ((1/(1 + np.exp(-(V + V_mid_c)/V_den_c))) + (c_init - (1/(1 + np.exp(-(V + V_mid_c)/V_den_c))))*np.exp(-t/(np.abs((tau_c_min + (tau_c_max - tau_c_min)/(1 + np.exp((V_mid_c - 20 + V)/V_den_c)))/1000) + 1e-6))))) <= 1e-6

invariants.description: inactivation hc matches its exact clamp solution (V_mid_hc = V_mid_c + 11, V_den_hc = V_den_c)
total Ca (free + buffered, four compartments) changes only by the plasma-membrane fluxes j_Ca_N + j_NaCa_Ca (trapezoid integral)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(((Vol*(c_SL*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + (1 - c_SL - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER)) - (Vol*(c_SL*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + (1 - c_SL - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER))[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((j_Ca_N + j_NaCa_Ca)[1:]+(j_Ca_N + j_NaCa_Ca)[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-3*np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((j_Ca_N + j_NaCa_Ca)[1:]+(j_Ca_N + j_NaCa_Ca)[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) + 1e-23

invariants.description: NE never falls below its baseline NE_init

bc_sweep.rationale: clamped varicosity potential -90 to +30 mV (rest to action-potential peak); NE baseline 0-1 uM; k_IP3 (0 by default) up to a small value; other constants by factors 0.5-2. Gate initial values over [0, 1]; the free-buffer initial value must not exceed B_Ca_total (the bound buffer would be negative), so B_Ca_init spans 4-7.95 mM and B_Ca_total 8-16 mM.

baseline.reason: candidate: varicosity Ca transients / NE overflow per impulse (e.g. Brain & Bennett 1995-type data); needs owner choice.
